title: hal_bridge.c fails -Werror=switch-enum on native_sim (missing enum cases)
description: Found while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-6fg3 on AWS waves-base (native_sim/native/64, gcc 11.5, meshcore_gateway_adapter image): lichen/subsys/lichen/app_interface/hal_bridge.c:172 switch (app_class) does not handle LICHEN_APP_LOCATION_SOURCE_NONE/_ONBOARD_HARDWARE/_EXTERNAL_HARDWARE/_LOCAL_CLIENT, and hal_bridge.c:410 switch (source_class) does not handle LICHEN_HAL_TIME_SOURCE_* entries. The module hardening set in lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt makes -Wswitch-enum fatal (-Werror), so any image building CONFIG_LICHEN_APP_INTERFACE fails at compile. Likely convergence point with in-flight hal.h enum work; add the missing cases (or default) in hal_bridge.c.
